# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting Offgrid to
[pacsybusiness@gmail.com](mailto:pacsybusiness@gmail.com). Please do not disclose them publicly
until there has been a reasonable opportunity to investigate and fix them.

Include the version or commit you tested, the steps to reproduce, and what an attacker gains.
[SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) describes Offgrid's trust model and what counts as a vulnerability.
